levelNote: Bunpro and JLPT Sensei tag all four N4. This N3 row is contextual contrast/retrieval, not four newly asserted N3 requirements. N4 core introductions: n4-u01 なら, u05 たら, u06 と/regretば, u10 broaderば.

forms.formation: Nonpast dictionary/ない verb or い-adjective + と; noun/な-adjective + だと. Negative nominal でないと. Result clause supplies tense.
forms.teachingChoice: Route result and past discovery. Do not generalise a route statement to a universal guarantee. One-off requests after the learner's action use たら. と for discovery is not labelled as a chosen sequential-action conjunction.

forms.formation: Godan u-row to e-row + ば; ichidan drop る + れば; する→すれば; 来る→来れば(くれば). い→ければ; いい→よければ; ない→なければ. Noun/な-adjective ならば/であれば; negative でなければ.
forms.teachingChoice: Names the construction in scored attachment tasks. Conditional state/potential/negative and different-actor cases mean no blanket ban on requests. Does not mean logical if-and-only-if. Avoid competing ば/たら keys where both are acceptable.

forms.formation: Plain past + ら, including だ→だら. Noun/な-adjective だったら; い-adjective かったら; いい→よかったら; negative なかったら. Calendar time is contextual.
forms.teachingChoice: Arrival precedes the requested message. A suspended-train contingency does not assert an actual suspension. Negative conditional is if-not, not after-not. Past discovery may overlap と; no synonym contest.

forms.formation: Plain verb/い-adjective + (の)なら; noun/な-adjective + なら without simple だ. Clause + のなら for a nominalised premise.
forms.teachingChoice: Advice responds to Misaki's stated travel plan and happens before boarding. Do not assume all なら clauses are future or every たら alternative is impossible; teach the actual temporal contrast explicitly.

contrastSource.title: Wasabi teacher-authored conditional comparison
contrastSource.verified: Attachments, actual discovery, overlap, one-off requests, state/different-actor exceptions with ば, supplied-context なら. Independent authored examples only.
